snippet.title: Hollow Knight: Silksong - Sea of Sorrow - Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Voyage above and beneath a vast forgotten sea in Hollow Knight: Silksong's first giant expansion, releasing free for all players on December 11, 2026!

Watch the full Cherry Time presentation: https://youtu.be/M-QUgdcBpZU
